latency_protocol: P3 pooled blocks of 200 sequential single-order inferences (600 samples) after 300 warm-up calls, timed in-process with time.perf_counter_ns. Per-call timer excludes payload construction. Pooling is used because a tail quantile estimated from one block is unstable on a shared host.

parity.protocol: Same orders scored through predict_single and predict_batch, then compared element by element. Proves the low-latency path returns the validated model output, so the latency claim and the reported metrics cannot refer to different systems.

calibrator_parity.note: np.interp against X_thresholds_/y_thresholds_ reproduces sklearn IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip") exactly.

contention_guard.reason: fresh run is materially better (0.750 ms vs stored 0.908 ms)
